name: Rocq
typeSystem: Dependent types, Calculus of Inductive Constructions; identical in substance to Coq's type system, carried over under the new project name.
runtime: The Rocq kernel checks proof terms and evaluators reduce terms inside the proof assistant, exactly as in Coq; extracted programs can run through OCaml, Haskell, or Scheme toolchains.

runtimes.name: Rocq/Coq evaluator and proof kernel
runtimes.role: Evaluators reduce terms for commands such as Compute, while the trusted kernel type-checks proof terms.

runtimes.name: Extraction (OCaml/Haskell/Scheme)
runtimes.role: Extracts verified code to a host language so it can actually run.

compilers.name: rocq compile
compilers.role: The renamed successor to coqc; compiles and checks Rocq (formerly Coq) developments.

concurrencyModel: N/A (proof assistant; extracted code inherits target language's model)

codeExample.caption: Same core syntax as Coq, now under the Rocq name
codeExample.source:
Fixpoint factorial (n : nat) : nat :=
  match n with
  | O => 1
  | S p => n * factorial p
  end.

Compute factorial 10.
